name: generative-ui
description: Show an interactive view with show_ui and update_ui, a widget in the conversation that opens the view's own window, when the user can decide, enter or understand something better by seeing and handling it than by reading and typing, such as comparing visual options, filling in several related values, exploring data, an interactive explanation or a preview. Load it before a task's first view. Not for answers that read well as text, code, files the user wants as files, a single question with a few short answers (ask_user), or a lasting tool the user will open again (create-app).
